Job Overview |  | We are seeking a high-caliber Senior System Analyst to join our team in Riyadh. You will translate business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear functional and technical requirements across integration services, event streaming, the developer portal, reporting, and operations. You will also coordinate interface requirements with the AI engineering workstream, while AI model design, development, and training remain outside this role.
